question: Pamban Port is located in which state of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pamban Port** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• Pamban is situated on the **Pamban Island**, also known as **Rameswaram Island**, which lies between the Indian mainland and Sri Lanka.
 
• Pamban Port is renowned for its proximity to the historic **Pamban Bridge**, which connects the mainland with Rameswaram Island.
 
• The port plays a crucial role in facilitating local trade and fishing activities, as it is located near the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• Pamban Island is a significant religious destination, housing the **Rameswaram Temple**, which is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• The location is strategically important as it serves as a gateway for maritime activities between India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The area is also known for its **natural beauty** and **tourism**, attracting visitors from across the globe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• **Maharashtra** is home to several major ports such as **Mumbai Port** and **Jawaharlal Nehru Port** (JNPT), which are among the busiest ports in India.
 
• Mumbai Port is one of the oldest ports in India, situated on the western coast along the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• These ports primarily handle large-scale trade and industrial activities.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**__
 __
 
• **Karnataka** has prominent ports such as **New Mangalore Port**, located on the western coast along the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• This port is crucial for the export of agricultural products, minerals, and petrochemicals.
 
• Karnataka is also known for its rich cultural heritage and coastal tourism.
 
 
 
• **Kerala**__
 
 
• **Kerala** is famous for its ports like **Cochin Port**, situated on the western coast along the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• Cochin Port is a major hub for trade, particularly spices, seafood, and oil.
 
• Kerala is also known for its scenic backwaters and maritime activities.
